svg.title: Cycle facilities
svg.desc: Cycle facility source case 5. Source claims: cycling. Longitudinal extent 6 m and decorative ground thickness are illustration assumptions. People 1.75 m, riders 1.65 m with 0.60 m bars. Manual chair/user dimensions .72 × 1.20 m and 1.35 m seated height are illustration assumptions. Actor placement does not verify capacity or clearance.
